title: Four Pages and One Stamp
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：person　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 person 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The decision was not difficult and it was not mine. My aunt, who had run the shop for thirty-one years, had decided to close it, and she had decided that I should be the ① person who signed. I am not a morning ② person and I do not like forms, and I had said no twice. She said the registrar would not accept a letter, that the person named on the form had to appear in ③ person, and that the train ticket cost eleven pounds per ④ person, which she had already checked.

The form ran to four pages and asked, on the second, whether the applicant was a natural person or a legal ⑤ person. I read it three times. The shop, it turned out, had been a person since 1998, with its own name, its own debts and, in the ⑥ person of my aunt, its own way of refusing to answer letters.

That was the sentence that decided me: a thing can be a ⑦ person for thirty years and still be closed on a Tuesday. I went in ⑧ person on the Thursday, which was what she had wanted all along, and took with me the letter she had written in the third ⑨ person, because she said it sounded more final.

The clerk read it and asked whether I had anything on my ⑩ person by way of identification. I had the letter, the form and a photograph of the shop taken in 1974. He stamped the form, said that was the end of the shop, and I thanked him; neither of us mentioned that it had been a person.

My aunt died in the spring. What I remember of the Thursday is how often the word appeared on four pages of paper, and that the decision, which was never really mine, had been made by somebody else and only signed by me.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 法人；法律上的人（a legal / juridical person）
C. 固定搭配：in person 亲自；本人到场
D. 固定搭配：in the person of sb. 即某人；体现在某人身上
E. 固定搭配：per person 每人
F. 固定搭配：the first / third person 第一／三人称（语法）
G. 固定搭配：on one's person 随身（携带）；在身上
H. n. ……类型的人；……样的人（a morning person）

items.q: a natural person or a legal person
in the person of my aunt
a thing can be a person for thirty years
I went in person on the Thursday

answers.why: the person who signed 指“签字的那个人”，取“人；个人”义。
a morning person 意为“习惯早起的人”，说我不属于这一类人。
in person 意为“亲自、本人到场”，说表格上具名的人必须亲自去。
per person 意为“每人”，指火车票每人十一英镑。
a legal person 意为“法人”，与 natural person（自然人）相对。
in the person of sb. 意为“即某人、体现在某人身上”，说店拒绝回信的作风就体现在姑妈身上。
a thing can be a person 仍取“人（此处指法律主体）”的基本义，说一件东西可以做三十年的人。
in person 意为“亲自”，我星期四亲自去了登记处。
the third person 意为“第三人称”，姑妈用第三人称写信，说这样听起来更决绝。
on one's person 意为“随身、在身上”，店员问我身上有没有带身份证明。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她决定由我来签字。（the person who signed）
我不是一个爱早起的人。（a morning person）
表格上具名的人必须亲自到场。（in person）
火车票每人十一英镑。（per person）
那家店自 1998 年起就是一个法人。（a legal person）
店员问我身上有没有带身份证明。（on one's person）
answers: She decided that I should be the person who signed.
I am not a morning person.
The person named on the form had to appear in person.
The train ticket cost eleven pounds per person.
The shop had been a legal person since 1998.
The clerk asked whether I had anything on my person by way of identification.
